messages:
ana_sec: Quick thread 1: need a short plan for per-repo KMS keys, RBAC tightening, and an image-attest rollout before the audit. Can we align on who owns what?
michael_infra: I can take the KMS/IAM changes. We should avoid sole owner keys; propose a service account per-pipeline + a small ops group w/cryptoSigner role.
devon_build: CI changes required: key generation in CI, cosign-writes to Rekor, SBOM upload to artifact bucket, then emit audit event. Can provide a sample workflow.
tara_prodsec: Gate: if SBOM shows critical CVE in base layers, fail build and create high-priority rebuild task. Also want an admission webhook that verifies cosign attestation + Rekor inclusion.
audit-bot: scan: base-image-202309 flagged openssl CVE-2023-XXXX severity: high. (auto)
leo_sre: For audit sink: logger-audit-prod for nearline, mirrored to gs://security-archive for 2y retention. Event schema: event_type, repo, commit, image_digest, signer_key, signer_identity, rekor_index, sbom_path, attest_path, build_id, ts.
michael_infra: IAM template: build-SA gets roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner on repo key and roles/logging.logWriter for audit emit. Ops group gets roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter? No, only signer role.
devon_build: sample cosign commands for CI snippet:
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign generate-key-pair --kms projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/repo-key
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/repo-key gcr.io/redwood/my-app@sha256:...
curl -X POST https://logger-audit-prod.redwood.internal/events -d '{"repo":"my-app","commit":"...","image":"sha256:...","signer":"repo-key","rekor":12345}'
tara_prodsec: Key compromise runbook (brief): revoke key, mark images signed by key as suspect, trigger rebuild for affected repos, update admission webhook to block that key, notify customers and legal. I'll draft full runbook.
nana_sec: small correction: it's "tara_prodsec" not "nana" :)
leo_sre: Rollout notes: During rollout window webhook should allow a grace period for newly-signed images (label them "pending-attest-registration"). After grace period, enforce strict verification.
michael_infra: I'll open INFRA-9701 for key templates + IAM docs and attach the IAM JSON.
devon_build: I'll add INFRA-9702 for CI cosign/rekor steps and example artifact paths.
tara_prodsec: ETA: I'll drop initial runbook draft in this thread by Tuesday.
nana_sec: thanks everyone, meeting in 20 to finalize. If you can't make it, paste notes here. :thumbsup:
